# Turn a Payoneer currency statement into a Xero or QuickBooks journal with the FX gain or loss

> Free Payoneer to QuickBooks and Xero journal converter for multi-currency balances: values every row in your base currency at your rates, tracks average cost, books realised FX gain or loss separately, proves the running balance, and downloads a balanced month-split journal. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
